name: SignNow MCP Server
description: Sends documents for eSignature, builds templates, tracks signing and embeds signing flows from agents through SignNow's hosted MCP.

skills.name: Send for signature
skills.description: Sends documents and document groups for signature in a role-based signing order.

skills.name: Templates and pre-fill
skills.description: Creates reusable templates from documents and pre-fills document fields with data.

skills.name: Track signing
skills.description: Tracks each document's signing progress and downloads the completed, signed documents when they finish.
